does: Writes one stats roll into a tooltip's trans string: the die term through gui::StatsExprStringBuilder::Roll, then, unless the roll's result is a critical failure (Critical = 2 at the roll's +0x2C), the roll's own modifiers (its flat bonus, roll bonuses, ability and skill modifiers) and, when asked, ' = ' and the total (+0x20). A roll flagged critical failure is written as its die alone, so a damage die of 1 on a 1dN weapon roll shows '1 (1d4 Piercing)' with no modifier and no total, while the damage dealt has both.

evidence.says: slot 2 of the builder's virtual table at +0x55EE970; the same sequence of loca handles (h613ff7dd, h5b45ed1d, h6143324b, h4c5b5289) and lists (+0xF8, +0xE8, +0x80, +0xC0) as the macOS build's gui::StatsExprStringBuilder::StatsRoll; one test of the byte at +0x2C against 2 guards every term after the die

a probe with a 64-byte snapshot of the third argument over a dagger hit: die 1 -> natural 1, total 4, flat 3, Critical 2, line '1 (1d4 Piercing)'; die 2 -> Critical 0, '2 (1d4) + 3 (Dex) = 5'; die 4 -> Critical 1, '4 (1d4) + 3 = 7'; the server's Critical set to None in Ext.Events.BeforeDealDamage on a 1 gave '1 (1d4) + 3 (Dex) = 4', set to Fail on a 4 gave '4 (1d4)'; an attack die of 1 gives '1 (Critical!) (1d20)'
